diagnosed_failures: Replaced the former floating two-second whole-body interpolation with the original front/back get-up tracks and weighted-skin floor alignment.
The first shirt-grip exercise could not reach a torso-joint target. Targets now use the actual closest shirt skin and gradual two-bone reach before applying any grip force.
Crossed-forearm tests exposed residual trunk intrusion. Final blended poses now use sampled forearm separation toward their anatomical side; forearm/torso Bullet collision is enabled.

Cloth telemetry previously depended on exact timestamp multiples and missed rendered samples under concurrent build load. Reports now use elapsed intervals; final regression requires actual deformed shirt samples.

The backward-pass test originally required a new log even when native ball control already turned correctly. It now measures body facing, clip selection and completed foot contact; an abrupt reversal-on-release also exercises the explicit turn-before-pass path.
F7 now resets the partner as well and releases disabled contact constraints. Protective resistance grows gradually with the arm preparation instead of changing instantly.
limitations: Locomotion uses native animated root/legs plus physical/procedural upper-body adjustments. Falls are articulated; get-up is authored animation with surface-ground alignment, not a learned muscular controller.
The contact partner is a scripted training actor. The full match retains native CPU movement, tackles and collision responses; it is not a shared 22-player rigid-body simulation.
M tests body contact within 0.56 m and does not award ball possession. Existing native tackles remain in the match.

The shirt is a bounded low-resolution XPBD shell on existing trunk vertices, with empirical visual parameters. There is no full garment tearing, sleeve fold simulation or general cloth self-collision.

Body collision capsules and final arm/trunk envelopes improve penetration; they cannot guarantee zero triangle intersection in every pose or obstacle arrangement. Hands have no separate articulated fingers.
Existing animations are adapted procedurally. Hundreds of new plays were not reconstructed by rotoscoping full matches; only the previously documented short kicking sequences were studied.
The pre-existing intermittent Chest_Run case remains recorded in docs/player-match-validation.json and is not claimed fixed by this physical-contact revision.
Windows GUI performance and a physical Xbox controller were not tested in this cloud environment.
